chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who sleeps and did not see in his sleep that he had a nocturnal emission, then he found water on his garment and on his thigh. Is ghusl (ritual bath) obligatory upon him? He said: Yes.

key_terms.الْمَاءَ: the fluid, referring here contextually to semen
key_terms.غُسْلٌ: ritual bath required for major ritual impurity

ai.seo_question: Is ghusl obligatory if someone finds semen after sleep but does not remember a nocturnal emission?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purity after sleep. If a person finds seminal fluid on his clothing and thigh, ghusl (ritual bath) is required, even if he does not remember experiencing iḥtilām in his sleep.
